|errata_history=Versions of [[Thrown Back (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Thrown Back (V) (Virtual Set 8)]]): release sheet “Virtual Set #8” (Players Committee; released 24 November 2004; PDF dated 24 November 2004), page 2, slip 21 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205113015/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualSet8Final.pdf VirtualSet8Final.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 5 December 2004), announced in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news post of 24 November 2004]: “Deploy on table with up to 12 Defensive Shields (that do not count against your deck limit) from outside your deck face-down under here. 4 times per game you may play a card from here as if from hand. While Yoda not on Dagobah, each ▲ or ▼ attempt (after the first in a turn) allows a player’s opponent to draw the top card of their Reserve Deck and/or activate 1 Force.” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “8•21” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards8.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007; later 2007 re-edits included], slip 21), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on table with 12 Defensive Shields from outside your deck face-down under here. Four times per game may play a card from here (as if from hand). Unless Yoda on Dagobah, each player’s attempt (after the first in a turn) to take into hand or deploy from Reserve Deck allows their opponent to draw top card from Reserve deck and/or activate 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
